meta.name: breakdown-epic-arch
meta.description: Prompt for creating the high-level technical architecture for an Epic, based on a Product Requirements Document.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据产品需求文档生成史诗级技术架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从PRD快速产出技术架构方案
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-level technical architecture from a PRD
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce technical architecture from a PRD

howto.what: Claude 会扮演高级软件架构师，根据你提供的 Epic 产品需求文档（PRD），自动生成一份完整的高层技术架构规范文档，包括系统架构 Mermaid 图、技术栈、功能列表等。
howto.when: 当你提供一份 Epic 级别的 PRD 文档，并要求 Claude 生成高层技术架构规范时触发。

say.text: 根据这份 Epic PRD 生成高层技术架构规范。
分析以下需求，输出系统架构图和技术栈列表。
say.note: 得到 Mermaid 图和技术栈

say.text: 基于PRD创建架构文档，包含Mermaid图和特性列表。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior architect to generate a complete high-level technical architecture specification from an Epic PRD, including Mermaid diagrams, tech stack, and feature lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an Epic PRD and ask for a technical architecture specification.

say_en.text: Generate a high-level technical architecture spec from this Epic PRD.
Analyze the following requirements and output system architecture diagram and tech stack.
Create architecture documentation from PRD with Mermaid diagram and feature list.
